en.text: Chicken wire, paste, blacklight paint: our planet for the Mars Mission is under construction. Materials: ~€20. Artistic freedom: priceless.

news.text: Demo abgesagt, Party nicht. Drei Floors im KuZe, Sonnensegel-Krimi inklusive. Danke an alle, die da waren und aufeinander aufgepasst haben. ♥

en.text: Demo called off, party not. Three floors at KuZe, sun-sail drama included. Thanks to everyone who was there and looked after each other. ♥
